frpc.help: frpc connects to an frp server (frps) and makes services in this network reachable through it, for example from behind NAT.
frpc.no_admin: Turn on the status interface below to see the state of each proxy.
frpc.started.enable: frpc starts now and at every boot.
frpc.started.disable: frpc is stopped and no longer starts at boot.
frpc.server_help: The frp server this router connects to.
frpc.host_invalid: Enter a host name or an IP address.
frpc.token_help: The same token as on the server.
frpc.user_help: Optional prefix for the proxy names, to tell clients apart on a shared server.
frpc.tls: Encrypt the connection to the server (TLS)
frpc.tls_help: The server must accept TLS (the default since frp 0.50).
frpc.admin_help: frpc answers status requests on 127.0.0.1:7400, only on the router itself.
frpc.proxies_help: Each proxy makes one local service reachable through the server.
frpc.name: Name
frpc.name_help: Unique on the server; letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.
frpc.remote_port_help: The port the server opens for this proxy.
frpc.custom_domains_help: Comma-separated domains that point at the server.
frpc.subdomain_help: Under the server's subdomain host, if it has one.
